ast.scope: Child source-bound partial syntax; no composed semantic AST.

obernants.assumptions: No corpus/teacher/API/GPU actions. No production behavior edits; only inline tests added to existing main/tests files. Existing score.rs remains unchanged. Runtime control coverage excludes lib declarations and tests fixture source as independent production components.
obernants.domain: Finite in-memory synthetic UTF-8 CoNLL-U with valid raw/index mappings and acyclic in-range trees, stable COREF_X/COREF_MD/PRAG_OFF snapshots. Native allocation/counter limits apply. Parser and malformed-input failure models explicitly distinguish weaker public/permissive adapters.
obernants.observation_scope: doc supplies kids/depth/sub/quote to mention and it; mention fields feed sieve masks/head keys/candidate order; sieve returns full membership (including internal mentions) to eval; visible tests full cluster length before filtering. eval::sys_entities recomputes head via corefud::span_head, whereas out_mentions writes detector head, so no universal head equality is claimed. score is existing external sibling ownership. main::load joins strict CoNLL-U reading and optional retree, then documents. tests assertions cross actual joins and do not substitute copied algorithms.
obernants.operator: For admitted default pipeline inputs, forbidden observations include Entity-dependent span/eid/note output, internal mentions in external entities, emitted unclosed/cross-sentence read mentions and cluster splitting. This relation is scoped: strip leak witness compares only span/eid/note; head/etype independence is not established by that check, and Nearest is outside default binding exclusions.

obernants.operator: R(output) is the set of raw documents, environment/config snapshots and merge traces whose parsing/detection/visibility/serialization equals the observation. Gold Entity variants, discarded syntax/comments, invisible mentions, OR-mask provenance and old MISC annotations can vary. After rebuilding Entity views from raw output, parsed generated output recovers span/eid pairs only for sentence-bounded, stack-compatible same-eid spans (including serialized e prefixes); valid crossing same-eid spans can reconstruct different spans. Existing Document views stay stale after raw write. Original text annotation, resolver trace and retree-discarded word DEPS are unrecoverable.

obernants.operator: Let C partition [0,M). Visible output filters v(m,C)=!internal(m) && !(coord(m)&&|C|=1&&!override), drops empty projected clusters, then assigns consecutive ids. A group plus one invisible member has |C|=2 and may survive; filtering and singleton detection do not commute.

obernants.operator: Aggregate Counts=sum over aligned documents, then compute ratios/F1. Averaging per-document F1 is a different function. Empty denominators in scorer map0, whereas CLI mention-stat raw recall/precision can print NaN; do not unify their zero semantics.
